packageRules.description: TS 6 breaks type-aware linting of eslint.config.mts: @types/node stops resolving for it, so import.meta.dirname and even node: imports become error types and no-unsafe-assignment fails. TS 7 additionally breaks eslint-plugin-obsidianmd, which reads ts.TypeFlags (undefined in the native rewrite). Both need upstream work; see AGENTS.md.
